title: Existing patient booked a day Dr. Smith does not work

transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like an appointment with Dr. Smith please.
Certainly. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Tom Delgado, August twenty-second, nineteen seventy-two.
Thanks, Tom. Are you a new or an existing patient?
Existing. I've been seeing him for years.
Dr. Smith has Monday at 10 AM, Wednesday at 2 PM, or Friday at 2 PM.
Thursday morning works. I've booked you for Thursday at 10 AM.
